reviewNotes: Twenty-five crash, loading, building, dating, bouquet, engagement, and marriage strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover the unchanged support URL, placeholders, exact dialogue and slash structures, gender-neutral dynamic references, emotional voice, punctuation, capitalization, and UI clarity; both found no remaining objective issue.
